title: Transport Money
intro: App-based transport everywhere: DiDi (China), Grab (Vietnam). Beijing subway excellent. Hybrid money strategy: WeChat Pay + US credit cards + ATM cash. Vietnam more cash-reliant at street level. No street taxis — profile deal-breaker.

tables.caption: Within Beijing
rows: Tiananmen, Temple of Heaven, Summer Palace, Sanlitun
Best urban transit; bilingual signage; get IC card at PEK
Great Wall day, late nights, luggage-heavy trips
English mode; pay Visa/MC or WeChat; never negotiate

tables.caption: Within Hanoi
rows: Old Quarter sites (Hoan Kiem, temples, markets)
Pre-select destination; app or cash payment
Street taxis at Noi Bai Airport
Use Grab or hotel car only

tables.caption: Within Đà Nẵng / Hội An
rows: Đà Nẵng city; Hội An day trips
Hội An Ancient Town; An Bang Beach
Use Grab or pre-arranged resort car

tables.caption: Recommended Cards
rows: Zero FX fees; reimburses ALL ATM fees globally
Multi-currency; competitive rate; load CNY/VND in advance
3x travel points; no FX fee; trip delay insurance
Notify of China AND Vietnam travel

bullets.heading: Beijing Airport → Hotel
items: Option A (Recommended): Airport Express Train T3 → Dongzhimen → DiDi last mile; ¥35/person; 30 min; 6 AM–11 PM
Option B: Hotel car via The Peninsula; ~¥400; English-speaking driver
Option C: DiDi from airport after clearing customs (DiDi Hitch for English interface)
Avoid: Unmarked taxis at arrivals — notorious overcharging

bullets.heading: DiDi Setup (China)
items: Download before China entry; link US Visa/Mastercard
Set to English in Settings > Language; DiDi Express or Comfort class is fine
WeChat Pay: Link foreign Visa/Mastercard — works at most vendors including smaller shops

bullets.heading: Money Strategy
items: China: ATM at Bank of China or ICBC; WeChat Pay for most vendors; avoid DCC — always pay in CNY
Vietnam: ATM at Vietcombank or Agribank; more cash-heavy for street food, markets, tailors
Withdraw larger amounts less frequently; use ATMs at bank branches or inside 4–5 star hotels
Beijing: Withdraw ¥2,000–3,000 at airport; Vietnam: ₫2,000,000–3,000,000 at Noi Bai

bullets.heading: Daily Budget Estimates (2 travelers)
items: China: ¥2,000–3,000/day ($280–420) — hotel, 2 meals, transport, incidentals (accommodation separate)
Track with Trabee Pocket or Trail Wallet; log expenses each evening

callouts.text: Subway/Grab/DiDi strategy fully implemented — no street taxi use anywhere
All transport legs covered with booking platforms and cost estimates
Avoid dynamic currency conversion (DCC) — always choose local currency at card terminals
Book Beijing → Hanoi flight as open-jaw with international ticket when possible
